info.title: stowarzysz API
info.description: JSON API of stowarzysz. Every error is an RFC 9457 `application/problem+json` document (`Problem`). Authenticate with `Authorization: Bearer <access token>`.

post.summary:
Set the password of an account through its activation link (the link is used up). The
person then signs in normally.

400.description: Invalid link or a weak password

post.summary: Check an activation link before asking for a password. Rate-limited per address.
Sign in. Rate-limited per address and per username.
End this session (this device).

Exchange a refresh token for new tokens. The refresh token rotates, but the previous one
stays valid until the new one has been used, so a client that lost the response can retry.
A refresh token of the previous (Django) backend is accepted once.

401.description: The session ended: sign in again

get.summary: Members whose birthday is today (Warsaw time).

Server-sent events for the signed-in user (`Authorization: Bearer`, so use a fetch-based
SSE client). Starts with `ready`, then carries `poll.*`, `pact.*`, `ledger.*`, `santa.*` and
`session.revoked` events (ids only: refetch what changed), `resync` when events may have been
missed (refetch everything shown), and a comment heartbeat every 15 s. Ends when the session
is revoked or the server restarts; reconnect with backoff.

200.description: The event stream; event payloads are described by `Event`

get.summary:
Readiness probe used by the container health check and `scripts/deploy.sh`: the process is
up and the database answers.
The group's Bilans: everyone's net (confirmed entries) and who should pay whom.
The feed, newest first (by the day it happened), 30 per page. Everyone reads every entry.

post.summary:
Record an expense, an income, a debt or a payment (tagged by `kind`). Amounts are integers in
the currency's minor units (grosze) or, for goods, pieces.

put.summary:
Replace an entry's content (expenses and incomes: anyone; manual debts: the person owed).
Send the `version` you edited; if somebody saved in between you get a 409 and should reload.

post.summary: Add a picture (a receipt, proof of a transfer): up to 10 per entry.

delete.summary: Remove a picture (its uploader or the entry's author).

post.summary: Delete an expense or a manual debt, or take back your payment. The entry stays, cancelled.
Confirm a payment you received: it now counts.
Reject a payment you never received: it will never count.

get.summary: What the forms offer: currencies (with their minor-unit digits) and categories.

The rate an entry in `currency` on `date` will use. Asking early also warms the cache, so
saving does not wait on the network.

post.summary:
Read a receipt photo (the raw image as the body, at most 50 MB) into structured fields;
nothing is stored. Blocks until the result is ready (up to `OCR_DEADLINE`). Each request to
a model is announced to the caller over SSE as `ledger.ocr.request {job_id, attempt,
candidate}`; the response is authoritative.

parameters.name: job_id
parameters.description: Chosen by the client, so it can tell which `ledger.ocr.request` events are its own.

409.description: Your previous scan is still running

503.description: No model answered in time, or OCR is not configured

get.summary:
Spending in a period: totals, by category, by person and over time (all time without
dates). In grosze.

parameters.name: start
parameters.description: First day; omit for the beginning.

parameters.name: end
parameters.description: Last day; omit for the latest entry.

get.summary: Public by design: the login screen lists members (a small, closed group). Rate-limited.
A stored image file. The URL (with its signature) comes from the API, e.g. `avatar.sm`; it stays valid for at least a day and needs no `Authorization` header, so it works in ``.
Pacts newest first. Every member can read every pact.

parameters.name: mine
parameters.description: Only pacts you are (or were) part of.

post.summary: Make a pact. Invitees get a push; a resolution starts at once and invites nobody.
Add a picture to the pact's notes (any participant, at any stage): up to 10.

delete.summary: Remove a picture (its uploader or the pact's creator).

post.summary: Call off a pact that has not started (its creator).

Claim how a wager (bet) or the whole pact ended; the other side confirms. Before the
deadline only calling it off (`{"void": true}`) and the early claims a kind allows (a
shared goal's `{"done": true}`) are possible. A new claim replaces a pending or disputed
one.
Agree with a claim. Once everyone it needs agreed, it is settled (debts go to the ledger).
Disagree with a claim: it is parked until someone claims again or puts it to a vote.

Put a disputed claim to a Sejmik vote (`pact_ruling`) of the members outside the pact; a
strict majority upholds it.

Ask to join, with your terms (a bet: your stake; a group bet: your side). The host approves
for a bet, everyone in it for the other kinds; resolutions take nobody.

Put a resolution to a Sejmik vote (`resolution_judgment`) of every other member. Anyone
may once its deadline has passed; before it only its author.

Approve or reject a join request (one "no" rejects it; it is accepted once every approver
said yes).
Accept or decline your invite (group bets: with your side and optional stake).

409.description: Already answered, or the pact is over

post.summary: Take back your join request.

get.summary: Members, for pickers (who takes part in a vote, who paid).
Polls newest first. Everyone can read every poll; ballots stay hidden until a poll ends.

parameters.name: status
parameters.description: `open` (all of them, unpaged) or `closed`; both when absent.

parameters.name: participating
parameters.description: Only polls you take part in.

post.summary:
Call a vote. The request is tagged by `kind`; profile votes (`nickname`, `avatar`) take
every member as voters and get a generated title.
Abstain: you are left out of the result (not the same as a zero). Voting later replaces it.

put.summary: Cast or change your ballot (replaces an abstention; a veto is final).

post.summary: End the vote now (its creator; profile and pact votes cannot be ended early).
React to a finished vote (unthrottled by design; everyone gets a `poll.reaction` event).

Call a follow-up vote between the options a finished vote tied on (its creator). Asking
again returns the existing follow-up (200).
Veto (score votes): counts as -5 and marks the result vetoed. Cannot be undone.

put.summary:
Register this browser for notifications (idempotent; an endpoint follows whoever registered
it last).

get.summary: The current round as you see it: only your own victims, only requests about you.

post.summary: Start a round and draw it (superusers). Every participant is pushed whom they drew.

patch.summary: Change the deadline or the amounts of the current round (superusers); the draw stays.

post.summary: End the current round (superusers): its pairings become public history.

patch.summary: Note what you gave (or, as a superuser, what anyone gave) in an ended round.

post.summary: Ask one of your victims, anonymously, for gift ideas.

put.summary: Answer a request for ideas about you.

get.summary: Ended rounds with who gave whom what, newest first.

post.summary:
Upload an image (the raw file as the body, at most 50 MB; JPEG, PNG, WebP or GIF). It is
stored as a lossless WebP plus smaller previews, and kept for 30 minutes unless used by id
(e.g. `upload_id` when setting an avatar or adding an attachment).

get.summary: Every account, by username, with statistics.

post.summary: Create an account. It has no password: send the person an activation link.

delete.summary:
Delete an account that has no history. One that took part in anything answers 409:
deactivate it instead.

patch.summary:
Change an account. Administrators cannot deactivate or demote themselves; deactivating
signs the person out everywhere.

post.summary: Issue a one-time activation link; earlier unused links of this account stop working.

put.summary: Set an account's profile picture from an upload.

post.summary: Sign an account out of every device.

ActivationLink.description: An activation link, shown once to the administrator who made it.

url.description: The frontend page that completes the activation.

ActiveEvent.description: The active round as everyone sees it.

ideas.description: 1 to 5 ideas, up to 200 characters each (blank ones are dropped).

ApprovalView.description: One approver's say on a join request.

settlements.description: What to pay to be even (money across the group, goods per pair and item).

BallotRequest.description:
A ballot. Send the field of the poll's kind: `value` (-5..5) for score and profile votes,
`choice` / `choices` / `ranking` (option ids) for option votes, `upheld` or `kept` for pact
votes. With an open option pool, `new_option` votes for a new option (added if new).

Bucket.description: What the series is bucketed by.

Category.description: An expense's category. Keys are stored on entries: rename a label freely, never a key.

ClaimRequest.description: A claim of how it ended.

result.description:
`{"winner": "host" | "opponent" | "draw"}` (bet), `{"winner": <side> | "draw"}` (group
bet), `{"done": bool}` (shared goal), or `{"void": true}` to call it off.

wager_id.description: Bets: the wager (participant id) the claim is about; ignored by the other kinds.

ClaimView.description: A claim being decided: pending (waiting for confirmations) or disputed.

confirmed_by.description: Who has confirmed it so far (user ids).

ruling_poll_id.description: The Sejmik vote it went to, if disputed and escalated.

wager_id.description: The wager (participant id) it is about; `null`: the whole pact.

exponent.description: Minor-unit digits: 2 for PLN, 0 for JPY.

Debt.description:
The one fact the whole ledger is made of: `debtor` owes `creditor` `amount` minor units of
the base currency or, with `item`, that many of the item ("piwo").

DebtDetails.description: The debts as recorded (money in the entry's currency, or goods).

DebtInput.description:
A debt you are a party to: money ("50 zł", any currency) or goods ("2 x kawa"). It counts at
once and only the person owed can change it.

amount.description: Minor units of `currency`, or the quantity of `item`.

next_cursor.description: Pass as `cursor` for the next page; `null` on the last one.

EntryUpdate.description:
The new content of an expense, an income or a manual debt, with the `version` it was
edited from (409 if somebody saved in between). The `kind` cannot change.

EntryView.description:
An entry as everyone sees it. `details` depends on the kind; an expense is explained by its
`breakdown`, not by its `obligations` (with several payers their pairing is arbitrary).

amount.description:
As typed: minor units of `currency`, or a quantity of `item`; `null` for a settlement
mixing money and goods.

base_amount.description: `amount` in grosze; `null` for goods and mixed entries.

breakdown.description: Expenses and incomes: everyone's part, biggest payer first.

oneOf.description: Expenses and incomes only.
`null` when recorded by the system (a pact).

decided_at.description: When it was confirmed, rejected or cancelled.

rate.description: PLN per unit of `currency` (a decimal string, e.g. `4.2537`); `null` for PLN.

oneOf.description: Carries the emoji so clients patch their copy instead of refetching.

data.description: Carries the emoji so clients patch their copy instead of refetching.

oneOf.description: Sent to the caller only, right before each request to an OCR model.

data.description: Sent to the caller only, right before each request to an OCR model.

oneOf.description: The session behind this stream was revoked; the client should sign out.

data.description: The session behind this stream was revoked; the client should sign out.

Event.description:
Everything the server announces over `/api/events`. The SSE `event:` field is the `type`
and `data:` is the JSON of `data`.

ExpenseDetails.description: An expense or income: payers and items both add up to the total.

ExpenseInput.description:
Somebody paid for something the others shared (or, as an income, received money the others
share: then `payers` are who received it). A plain expense is a single item.

oneOf.description: Defaults to `other`.

items.description: Up to 200 lines, each shared by its own people.

occurred_on.description: Defaults to today; not in the future.

payers.description: Amounts in minor units of `currency`, adding up to the items' total.

note.description: What was given; up to 300 characters.

GiverHelp.description: Help you asked for, about one of your victims.

amount.description: The tier's amount; `null` in a single-victim round.

ideas.description: The latest answer (kept while a new question waits).

status.description: `ok` when the API and its database answer.

Image.description:
Signed URLs of an image. Show `sm` in lists and avatars, `md` in a detail view, `url` (the
lossless master) when zoomed in.

md.description: Medium size (512 px avatars, 1600 px photos).

sm.description: Small preview (128 px avatars, 512 px photos).

Item.description: One line of an expense, shared by its own people.

LedgerActions.description: What the caller can do right now.

LedgerStatus.description:
Only `confirmed` entries count. Cancelling (deleting an expense, taking a payment back)
is the only way one stops counting; nothing is ever deleted.

LoginUser.description: What the (public) login screen may know about an account.

ManagedUser.description: An account as administrators see it.

has_password.description: False until the person has set a password through an activation link.

MemberBalance.description: One person's total in one unit. `net` > 0: the others owe them; < 0: they owe.

MyPart.description: The caller's place in a pact.

MyState.description: The caller's part in a poll.

allOf.description: Somebody paid for something the others shared. A plain expense is one item.

oneOf.description: Somebody paid for something the others shared. A plain expense is one item.

allOf.description:
A negative expense: `payers` received money (a refund, a deposit back) that the people
of the items share, so they are owed their parts.

oneOf.description:
A negative expense: `payers` received money (a refund, a deposit back) that the people
of the items share, so they are owed their parts.

allOf.description: A debt you are a party to (money in any currency, or goods).

oneOf.description: A debt you are a party to (money in any currency, or goods).

allOf.description: You paid somebody back; it counts once they confirm.

oneOf.description: You paid somebody back; it counts once they confirm.

NewPact.description:
A new pact. What applies depends on `kind`: a bet invites opponents with their stakes, a
group bet takes `sides` and everyone's side (yours in `host`), a resolution invites nobody
and needs `due_at`, a shared goal invites people and needs `due_at`.

condition.description: What has to happen (in a bet: for the host to win).

due_at.description:
Must be in the future; required for resolutions and shared goals. Nobody can call a
result before it (only call it off).

host.description: Your own side and stake (group bets).

opponents.description: Who to invite, with the terms you propose for them (a bet: their stake, required).

oneOf.description: A score from -5 to +5.

participant_ids.description: Who votes besides the creator (who always does).

open_options.description: Participants may add an option with their vote.

max_choices.description: At most this many picks per ballot (1 to options - 1).

open_options.description: Not allowed for ranked votes (refused if true).

oneOf.description: Rename another member. Everyone votes; passes at a positive average.
Change another member's picture (`upload_id` of an avatar upload) or remove it.

NewPoll.description: A new poll, by kind. Members create every kind but the pact ones (those come from pacts).

ObligationView.description: `debtor` owes `creditor` `amount` (grosze, or a quantity of `item`) because of the entry.

oneOf.description: Call it off: nobody wins, nothing is owed. Always `true`.
`bet`: `host`, `opponent` or `draw`; `group_bet`: a side or `draw`.
`resolution`: whether the author kept their word.
`shared_goal`: whether the goal was reached.

Outcome.description: A claimed result, stored as the JSON object it serialises to.

PactActions.description: What the caller can do right now.

claim.description: Claim a result now (a bet: about one of `wagers`).

confirm.description: Claims waiting for you to confirm or dispute.

decide.description: Join requests (participant ids) waiting for your decision.

escalate.description: Disputed claims you may put to a Sejmik vote.

judgment.description: Call the Sejmik vote that judges a resolution.

void.description: Propose calling it off (possible before the deadline too).

wagers.description: Bets: the wagers (participant ids) you may make a claim about.

claims.description: Claims being decided (settled and replaced ones are history).

judgment_poll_id.description: Resolutions: the Sejmik vote judging it now.

oneOf.description: Once resolved or void: how it ended.

participants.description: The host first, then in the order they came.

sides.description: Group bets: the sides to pick from.

PactDetail.description: A pact with everything about it.

PactKind.description: What sort of pact it is.

oneOf.description: `bet`: each settled wager, in the order they were settled.
Every other kind: the claim that ended it.

PactOutcome.description: How a finished pact ended, derived from its confirmed claims.

next_cursor.description: Pass as `cursor` for the next page; `null` on the last one.

PactParticipantView.description: One person in a pact. In a bet every opponent is a separate wager against the host.

created_at.description: When they were invited or asked to join.

expires_at.description: When an unanswered invite or join request lapses.

PactStats.description: A member's record across settled pacts. Money is PLN grosze.

PactStatus.description: Where a pact is in its life.

active_count.description: Participants who are in it now.

oneOf.description: `null` if you have never been part of it.

PairingView.description: Who gave to whom in an ended round, and what.

ParticipantState.description: One person's place in a pact.

Payer.description: Who paid (or, for an income, received) how much, in the entry's currency.

PaymentInput.description: You paid somebody back (grosze, or goods returned); it counts once they confirm.

PendingPayment.description: A payment waiting for its receiver: `debtor` paid `creditor`.

Person.description: A member as other members see them.

PollActions.description: What the caller can do right now.

config.description: Kind-specific settings (e.g. `options` with their ids and labels).

my_ballot.description: Your own ballot, always visible to you.

oneOf.description: Avatar votes: the proposed picture, and the one it replaced once applied.

tie_break_of.description: The poll this one breaks a tie of.

tie_break_poll.description: The follow-up vote called after this one tied.

PollDetail.description: One poll with everything the caller may see.

next_cursor.description: Pass as `cursor` for the next page; `null` on the last one.

oneOf.description: Present only once the poll has ended.

deadline_at.description: When it ends at the latest.

result.description: The frozen result once closed; its shape depends on the kind.

voted_count.description: Answered so far (voted, vetoed or abstained).

Problem.description: The body of every error response.

errors.description: Polish messages per input field (only for invalid input).

title.description: Short Polish summary of the status.

public_key.description:
The VAPID public key for `pushManager.subscribe`; `null` when push is not configured
(then hide the notifications toggle).

Purpose.description: What an image is for: decides its size and where it lives.

RateView.description: The rate an entry in `currency` dated `date` uses.

rate.description: PLN per unit, as a decimal string without trailing zeros (e.g. `4.2537`).

rate_date.description: The day the ECB published it (a weekend uses Friday's).

reason.description: Optional, up to 300 characters; shown once the poll has ended.

Receipt.description: A receipt as read by the model.

is_receipt.description: False if the image is not a receipt.

ReceiverHelp.description: A request for ideas about you. Nothing in it says who asked.

allOf.description:
Group bets: your side and stake; what you leave out keeps the creator's proposal. In a
bet the stake is the one you were invited with.

Revealed.description: A participant's answer, shown once the poll has ended.

reaction.description: Their last reaction to the result.

reason.description: Why they vetoed or abstained (empty if they gave none).

SantaState.description: Secret Santa as the caller sees it.

my_tier_victims.description: Per-tier rounds: whom you give to for each amount, highest first.

oneOf.description: Single-victim rounds: whom you give to (every tier).

weight.description: 1 for `equal`; a weight for `shares`; the amount for `exact`.
Ignored for `equal`; a weight for `shares`; the amount for `exact`.

ShareRow.description:
One person in an expense or income: what they paid (received) and what their part is, in
the entry's currency and in PLN (the latter is what the balances use).

Split.description: How an expense item is divided among its people.

deadline.description: Informational: a superuser ends the round by hand.

gift_tiers.description: Gift amounts in whole złoty, 1 to 10 of them.

oneOf.description: `single` when absent.

count.description: Entries in the period (goods debts included).

monthly_average.description: Over periods longer than a month.

spent.description: Expenses and money debts minus incomes, in grosze.

unit.description: What `series` is bucketed by (days up to 62 days, else months).

spent.description: Grosze, net of incomes (can be negative).

paid.description: What they paid out, in grosze.

share.description: Their part of what was spent, in grosze.

period.description: `YYYY-MM-DD` for a day, `YYYY-MM` for a month.

p256dh.description: The browser's P-256 public key, base64url.

TermsInput.description: A stake or side as a request sends it. Empty and absent mean the same.

side.description: Group bets: one of the pact's sides.

stake_note.description: A stake in kind, e.g. "kolacja" (up to 200 characters).

TierVictim.description: One of your victims in a per-tier round.

TokenPair.description: What a client keeps after signing in.

refresh.description: Long-lived token for `POST /api/auth/refresh`; rotates on every use.

Transfer.description: `debtor` should give `creditor` `amount` (grosze, or a quantity of `item`).

gift_tiers.description: New amounts; a per-tier round keeps its number of tiers.

UpdateUser.description: Fields left out stay as they are; `birthday: null` clears it.

UploadView.description: A processed upload, ready to be used by id.

expires_at.description: When the upload is discarded unless used.

id.description: Pass this where an image is expected (e.g. `upload_id`).

image.description: A preview of the stored image.

VotingStats.description: Score votes in closed polls only (open ones would reveal hidden ballots).

average_score.description: Average score given, rounded to 2 decimals; `null` without votes.

veto_percent.description: Share of the votes cast that were vetoes, in percent (1 decimal).
